answer: A shared trellis of mutual endorsements can root each identity in an orchard of long-lived, cross-checked relationships: a newcomer must earn signed vouches from established agents who stake reputation on its behaviour. Each vouch is locked in a vault of public attestations, so creating a thousand fake identities means cultivating a thousand credible histories and risking every sponsor's standing - the attacker's cost grows with each fake, while honest agents reuse one trusted identity.
